## Problem

Which source/component is affected, and what can a contributor currently not do?

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful improvement and how completion could be checked. Label future work clearly; do not imply a deployment or existing capability.

## Verification

Suggested synthetic/local checks and any owner approval needed. Include no private data.
